svg.title: Read a Claim About Wider Reach
svg.desc: Modern teaching cards: Starting point: The marker links Palapag and 1 June 1649.. Wider reach: It names spread into areas of the Visayas, Mindanao and Luzon.. Limit: Reported spread is not proof that every resident joined or every local action was identical.
